stories.title: Fire service training exercise at Flint tower block tonight

stories.title: Sir Tom Jones to headline Llangollen Pavilion in June 2027
stories.summary: Sir Tom Jones will play an outdoor headline show at Llangollen Pavilion on Monday 28 June next year. Tickets for the fully seated concert go on sale at 10:00 GMT on Friday 20 November through llangollen.net and Ticketmaster. stories.title: Flintshire residents sought as volunteer police custody visitors
stories.summary: People in Flintshire are being asked to apply to become volunteer custody visitors, making unannounced checks on people held in police cells in North Wales. stories.title: Go-ahead for £180m A494 River Dee Bridge replacement at Queensferry
stories.summary: The Welsh Government has given the go-ahead for the new A494 bridge over the River Dee at Queensferry. Deputy Minister for Transport Mark Hooper decided on 27 October that this much-needed improvement can proceed, according to a decision letter dated 13 November.
